notes.title: Stories Are Live in Passion Rift!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44758768/0dbfc53f84fa01fa1bcd66124ab151e02c54079f.png[/img]

Your favorite Stars now have their own mini-arcs. Play through a short chain of tasks, grab rewards along the way, and unlock a special date + scene at the end. Simple, guided, and super satisfying.

🙋‍♂️ How It Works?
• Short & sweet: Each Story is a focused set of tasks you can clear at your own pace.
• Steady rewards: Every task gives a little something; finishing the Story unlocks the big finale.
• Play as you like: Tasks match what you already do (Adventures, merges, spending Energy, opening chests). Just keep playing and check off objectives.
• More time with your faves: Dialogues and a scene that spotlight the Star you’re following.

🎁 What You Get?
• On the way: Currency, items, and other handy goodies for each task you finish.
• The finale: A short date that leads into a scene: your reward for completing the Story.

So dive in, chase the rewards, and unlock the scenes!
Don’t let your favorite Star’s story pass you by! See you in game!

With intent, JNT Corp. Reality Division
Watching. Waiting. Always filming. 🎥

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift/]Passion Rift on Steam![/url]

notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44758768/60e8369c12ba8f22a3ed8a211a560f47f94a137b.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the show across worlds!

We’re live. Passion Rift is a surreal multi-realm reality show where you build a squad, shape evolving relationships, and compete in automated battles while making quick decisions under pressure. Expect striking visuals, juicy storylines, and progression you can feel every session.

[h3][b]What’s inside:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Idle combat: assemble your squad and let them battle through waves of enemies using unique skills and synergies.
[*] Character progression: unlock skills, gear, perks, and rise to global fame.
[*] Flirt system: build bonds, unlock dialogues, and collect cute outfits for each girl.
[*] Corporate intrigue: uncover the dark truth behind the portal and the show's creators.
[*] Reality show survival: compete, progress, and become a global star… or die trying.
[*] Explore alien worlds: dangerous dimensions filled with monsters, tech, and secrets.
[/list]

notes.content:

[h3][b]🌀Portal. 🌟 Fame. 👹 Monsters. 🔥 Desire. ☠️ Death.
Welcome to the Rift![/b][/h3]

A mysterious portal has opened on a tropical island in the Seychelles. Will they fall for your charm — or leave you behind?
